extras: Uses unsigned uploads for security reasons.
intentEvidence: This plugin will make all files (images, video, audio) dragged or pasted in the editor, upload to Cloudinary Media Library rather than file system.
problem: Local media files can be difficult to share, access, or manage across devices and consume local storage.

relations.evidence: the base of this plugin is from their work.

summary: Cloudinary is a plugin that uploads media files (images, video, audio) dragged or pasted into Obsidian to a Cloudinary storage account, providing accessible links instead of local files.
